invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata, likely never null after successful execution.
The input records list should not be null at this point, as it is required for the insert operation.
instantTime is required for the operation and should be non-null when the method returns.
The engine context is needed for execution, and must not be null.
getWriteStatuses() provides the main result from the metadata and should never be null.
